goal: Avoid reporting that wallet encryption failed when the wallet was already successfully encrypted on disk
Prevents misleading error messages to RPC callers if re-unlocking the wallet fails
reviewability: Reviewing now is worthwhile as nothing invalidates a review
agreement: Blocking objection: unlock failure means corruption so wallet should halt rather than just log (achow101)
Author acknowledged that logging may be wrong but has not yet pushed an updated fix
Questions raised about consistency with past wallet changes and failure behavior (katesalazar)

categories.name: wallet
why: P4 because the misleading error only occurs in an extremely rare edge case
Triggering an unlock failure after encryption requires memory corruption or synthetic test mutation
